title: Fourth Page of the Tianji
next_chapter_hook: The puppet's final screech echoed in the air, and that name cut into Chen Ji's heart like a dull blade—Chen Nian, seven days remaining.

text.content: The moment the token entered his palm, a scalding torrent rushed from his palm into the depths of the Tianji Record. Chen Ji felt as if a door sealed for ten thousand years had been smashed open in his mind, and four streaks of golden light burst forth from the cracks in the fragment, weaving into an enigmatic talisman.

【Tianji Record Fourth Page—Unsealed】

The ancient Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul trembled violently in the depths of consciousness, his voice carrying undisguised excitement: "Fourth page... Observer of Fate... You've finally touched upon the second realm of glimpsing heavenly secrets."

dialogue.content: "The first realm is foreseeing possibilities three hours into the future, and the second realm is—" Mo Xiansheng paused, "seeing through every move of an opponent's strategy."

text.content: Chen Ji had no time to ponder further. The puppet's aura was already closing in, a mere three zhang behind him, the thick scent of rust mingling with scorched death energy that nearly suffocated him. He猛地侧身, and a black shadow grazed his sleeve, shattering the stone tablet beside him into powder.

The puppet's entire body was pitch black, assembled from dozens of fragmented battle armor pieces, with ghostly green phosphorescent fire flickering at its joints. Within those hollow eye sockets burned twisted resentment—this was an ancient war spirit forcibly refined, its owner having been at least a Foundation Building Peak cultivator in life.
It rampaged through the ruins, each step kicking up clouds of dust. Within moments, Chen Ji was driven into a desperate situation—a bottomless chasm before him, relentless killing intent behind him.

Yet the corner of his mouth lifted slightly.

"In three breaths, its left shoulder will drop half an inch." This thought emerged instinctively from the Tianji Record, Chen Ji's pupils constricting—he could see it, the puppet's next attack trajectory was now clearly laid out before him.

dialogue.content: "So this is... the true meaning of 'using one's own path to return the favor.'" Chen Ji murmured softly, a sharp gleam flickering in his eyes.

text.content: He stopped retreating, instead moving toward the puppet. This举动 was bizarre—the puppet clearly hadn't expected its prey to come to it voluntarily, the phosphorescent fire in its hollow sockets激烈跳动.

Three breaths.

The puppet's left shoulder indeed dropped half an inch, its rusted copper claws slashing diagonally toward Chen Ji's throat. At that moment, Chen Ji's form ghostly shifted to the side, barely evading the lethal strike, while he slapped the talisman he'd been clutching onto the puppet's nape.

choice.prompt: The moment the talisman activated, Chen Ji faced a critical choice—

choices.text: Guide toward the Dragon Vein Formation Core
choices.description: Lure the puppet into a preset trap, using Dragon Vein power to seal it completely. Low risk, but may miss the opportunity to gain intelligence.
choices.visible_reward: The puppet gets sealed, acquire intelligence fragments
choices.risk_hint: The puppet may self-destruct during sealing

text.content: The moment the talisman exploded, an invisible thread extended from the puppet's nape. Chen Ji retreated sharply, while his fingertips struck several positions in rapid succession,喝一声："起阵！"

choices.text: Attempt to Communicate with the Puppet's Consciousness
choices.description: The fourth page of the Tianji Record's power might allow Chen Ji to briefly invade the puppet's remaining consciousness, probing for information about the mastermind behind it. High risk, high reward.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain Complete Intel on the Mastermind Behind the Scenes
choices.risk_hint: May be Counterattacked by the Puppet's Consciousness

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, channeling the Tianji Record's power into his eyes. An unprecedented dizziness struck him, and his consciousness pierced into the puppet's chaotic remnant soul like a blade.

choices.text: Feign Weakness to Lure the Enemy, Then Strike the True Body
choices.description: Deliberately expose a flaw, tempting the mastermind to reveal themselves. Suitable for dealing with fools who think they control the overall situation.
choices.visible_reward: Expose the Enemy Hiding in the Shadows
choices.risk_hint: May Die on the Spot if Judgment is Wrong

text.content: A cunning gleam flashed in Chen Ji's eyes. He deliberately slipped, stumbling into the puppet's copper claws, blood instantly soaking half his robe. "Ah—!" A wretched cry rang through the ruins.

In the depths of the ruins, a formation pattern infused by the Dragon Vein for a thousand years suddenly illuminated beneath Chen Ji's feet. Golden light shot skyward, enveloping the puppet. The copper-skinned, iron-boned凶物 let out a piercing screech, its limbs struggling as it sank deeper and deeper.

Chen Ji wiped the blood from the corner of his mouth, looking down at the cornered puppet with detached interest. He wasn't in a hurry to deliver the killing blow, instead studying this exquisitely constructed war machine with curiosity.

dialogue.content: "Xuanwu Sect's armor forging techniques... the Demonic Path's soul refinement methods... and this familiar aura—" Chen Ji narrowed his eyes, his voice turning icy cold, "The Holy Sect's reach truly extends far."

text.content: The puppet's struggles grew weaker. Washed by the Dragon Vein's power, its remaining consciousness began to surface. Chen Ji activated the fourth page of the Tianji Record's ability, capturing frame after frame of blurred images—ancient Holy Sect's secret hall, a blood-colored altar, and a small figure bound by iron chains.

choice.prompt: The images Chen Ji captured grew increasingly clear, and he saw—

choices.description: That figure... was Chen Nian. His younger sister, missing for many years, now appeared on the altar of the Holy Sect's forbidden grounds.

text.content: Chen Ji's pupils constricted sharply. That figure bound by chains, that pale yet familiar face—it was his younger sister, Chen Nian. Sixteen years ago she was kidnapped, her whereabouts unknown. So it turned out, she had been there all along.

choices.text: Intercept the Image of the Mastermind Behind the Scenes
choices.description: Intelligence comes first. Finding out who is controlling all of this is the only way to completely break the situation.

text.content: Chen Ji suppressed the churning emotions, shifting his gaze away from his sister to pursue the faint trace of control within the puppet's consciousness. The images switched rapidly, finally freezing on a blurred figure—surrounded by eerie purple qi, wearing a jade crown.

The puppet let out one final mournful cry within the Dragon Vein Formation. Its pitch-black carapace began to crack inch by inch. Before completely dissipating, its remnant consciousness transformed into a faint fluctuation, sent into Chen Ji's mind—

"Hea...ven... Lock... Key... Seven... days... otherwise..." The断续的嘶鸣 was like a heavy hammer striking Chen Ji's heart. His fingers trembled slightly. That term he knew too well—Heavenly Fate Lock Key, a mysterious existence in legend capable of prying open the threads of heaven's destiny.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji lowered his eyelids, pressing all the churning emotions deep into the bottom of his heart. After a moment, he raised his head, a indifferent curve forming at the corner of his mouth: "Seven days... will be enough."

text.content: The ruins fell silent. The Dragon Vein Formation slowly dimmed, and the puppet's remnants turned into scattered ash. Chen Ji stood in place, the token in his hand still slightly warm. The talisman from the fourth page of the Tianji Record floated quietly in the depths of his consciousness, awaiting the next opportunity for awakening.

Mo Xiansheng's voice rang out again, carrying a hint of satisfaction: "Observer of Fate... you have taken your first steps through the gate. Next, the Holy Sect's forbidden grounds, the seven-day deadline, and your dear senior brother's schemes... this chess game has just entered the middle game."

Chen Ji gave no answer. He took one last look at where the puppet had dissipated, then turned and stepped into the night. Behind him, that lonely silhouette gradually merged into darkness, only the night wind carrying his low murmur—"Xiao Nian, wait for big brother seven more days."
